features.feature_and_expectation: Discover projects and identify recent work
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Partial.** Accessible root cards, missing-folder state and Resume exist. Recency uses creation time; UI calls it Updated. No home search/filter/list/pin/archive feature.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Home helpers and frontend tests; F06/F09 below. Search/pins are new UX, not failed existing requirements.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Exists with limits.** Last-project resume exists; active section is already persisted per project in browser storage. Guided/Expert share section context.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: `store/activeSection.ts`, `uiStore.ts`, project-actions tests. Do not propose building last-section resume from scratch. Browser key is project name, not a server-owned cross-device user/org preference.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented for existing paths; broader Builder remains planned.** Wizard supports blank/template/file/clone; specialized studies and local folder behavior remain mode-specific.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Wizard clone/home creation tests; creation/template backend paths reviewed. No full live-browser test of every example in this audit. Reuse existing paths and reconcile W2/#496, rather than invent another creator.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Substantial tested foundation.** Identity guards and per-file atomic writes; sidecars/config/results-state and user input series travel through explicit bundle paths.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Save guards, reload, sidecar tests and standalone save/load QA. A sequence of atomic file writes is not an all-or-nothing multi-file transaction. Browser autosave timing is not a full UI E2E result here.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented and targeted-tested.** Session-bound contexts, resident registry, save/switch logic and undo separation.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Project-switch/undo/session tests; frontend switch tests. Do not claim stale process-global warning is current architecture. Same-user multiple tabs and pending requests remain important release scenarios.

features.feature_and_expectation: Create independent variant from intended source
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented with explicit saved-source semantics.** Authenticated scenario creation copies the base's on-disk bundle. UI saves an active source first. Parent link does not make a live inherited configuration.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Scenario-type/tenancy/bundle tests; `projects._create_scenario_db`. Route docstrings referring to an in-memory fork are stale. Later base edits do not automatically propagate.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented; summary needs correction.** Scenario forest handles nested branches. Home count helper counts direct children only.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Forest/helper/frontend tests. Define direct-child vs family count; avoid flattening ancestry or creating a new variant table detached from existing project IDs.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented.** Scenario category is typed metadata; old description prefixes are migrated/tolerated.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Scenario-type/tenancy tests. Category baseline is a label, not a unique enforced comparison-baseline pointer. Generic root descriptions/client/tags remain new metadata work.

features.feature_and_expectation: Run one project or several variants
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented for native queue solves.** Scenario tree can queue a branch/subtree with confirmation, active-project save handling and duplicate protection. Queue captures config and stores job states.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Scenario panel/frontend tests; queue config/dedupe/authz tests. This does not certify a generic all-modules Run for every variant; the newer orchestration/scope work must supply that.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented with tested controls.** Cancel queued/running work, terminal status, explicit requeue, persisted listing and boot reconciliation.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Queue suites. Interrupted work is not silently called completed. Queue dismissal is a view/history action, not restore or deletion of every result artifact.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented for a limited write surface.** Per-context in-memory network/user-series undo, default 20 steps/500 MB and burst coalescing; save/load/reset can change the undo baseline.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Undo tests and middleware source. Not a durable history of commercial/config/sidecar changes, not batch rollback across variants, and not a universal redo/restore facility.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented for last-saved bundle files.** Source is on disk; explicit UI copy says Save first for unsaved edits. Maximum 50 saved snapshots with pruning.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Snapshot and bundle tests; router source. Not all project kinds/artifacts are covered: current snapshot route requires network.nc. Newest snapshot is labelled current without proving equality to the working model (F05).

features.feature_and_expectation: Restore a checkpoint and recover previous working state
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Fails stronger safe-revert expectation.** Successful saved-state restore/rekey is covered, but three fresh HTTP probes expose omitted unsaved changes and post-checkpoint state surviving.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: F01–F03 reproduced. Current UI safety-net wording overstates protection. No single-click safe full-project rollback should be promised yet.

features.feature_and_expectation: Compare exact saved version without restoring
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Missing exact-source integration.** Snapshot-row Compare opens general saved-project A/B rail without the clicked snapshot ID.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: F04 source-confirmed. Need source-bound version reader and request, or remove/rename misleading action.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented, detailed and tested; comparison basis incomplete.** Ten result tabs, availability states and numerical invariants exist. Scenario-row comparability only checks snapshot count; global Best objective spans the supplied project list.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Compare suites and F07. Keep the engines; add basis metadata and scoped ranking rules. Equality of counts is insufficient for a like-for-like comparison.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Planned, not complete native feature.** Existing compare is A/B. LC-18 and S6 specify base plus up to eight cases, software deltas and incompatibility reasons.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Source/plan comparison. Do not mark spec text as shipped. No need for a competing new comparison engine.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented for an explicit file/dir set.** Network/results/config and named sidecars, uploads/reports/studies/sites travel; licensed texts excluded. Raw network import is narrower.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Bundle/campus/Library tests and save/load QA. Document included/excluded artifacts. Sensitivity receipt, experiment history and retained run evidence are not universally covered by that allowlist (F10). No “everything in this folder” guarantee.

features.feature_and_expectation: Rename/delete without breaking descendants or active work
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented with confirmations/guards and tests.** Stable registry ID, rename updates, descendant/cascade checks, queue/lock refusals; deletion is permanent.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Tenancy/frontend/save-guard tests. Trash/soft-delete was expressly deferred by existing spec; Archive is new scope, not an incomplete trash implementation.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented and tested with specific semantics.** Membership is inherited through the root tree; locks are project-node/user keyed, not a single tree lock. Session-bound context resolves the active project.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: ACL/lock/tenancy tests. Workspace copy incorrectly describes root-owned lock/global active slot. No branch-private ACL or real-time same-project coediting claim.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented for native section/run contracts, still uneven across management.** Flow items target owning fields; acknowledgements are value-bound; result evidence is source-bound.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Project-flow and retained-evidence tests. A non-null objective is not enough to say all selected work is fresh or checked. A management summary must project canonical states, not invent a global green percentage.

features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Pieces implemented, not one complete project index.** Existing report store, uploads, sidecars, logs and retained evidence are separate sources.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Bundle/report/queue paths read; no full Files-view or audit-trail UI E2E exercised. Build an authorized summary/index; do not create a duplicate file or result store.

features.feature_and_expectation: Generate sensitivity variants from parameter changes
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Implemented in a bounded tool seam.** `run_sensitivity_sweep`: 1–4 new child cases, 1–20 changes each, six component classes, explicit attribute allowlist; isolated preflight, saved base, receipts/fingerprints, queue/reuse and partial outcomes.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: `workflow_tools.py` and tests. Static updates preserve time-series overrides. Not arbitrary tariffs/finance/horizon/process writes; not existing-variant bulk edit; not proof all higher-level conversational LC-17 work is complete.

features.feature_and_expectation: Change one assumption across existing variants
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **Not implemented as proposed.** Component bulk-update operates within one active model. Sweeps create cases; tree Run queues solves. Neither provides reviewed multi-variant common-assumption application.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Search/read across routes, scenario UI, workflow tools and sensitivity receipts. Recommend the bounded feature in `02-SHARED-ASSUMPTIONS-SPEC.md`.

features.feature_and_expectation: Run an earlier version without disturbing the working design
features.master_behavior_and_verdict: **No dedicated first-class action found.** A saved version can be restored before running, but that mutates working files and has the F01–F03 limitations.
features.evidence_and_remaining_work: Snapshot and queue contracts. Prefer an explicit isolated branch from the selected version, then ordinary queue execution; requires provenance and supported version-copy path, not a restore hidden behind Run.
